name: Summer@Taft
description_short: Academic enrichment programs at The Taft School in Watertown, mostly residential, for middle and high school students. Four week programs (Young Scholars for middle school, Liberal Studies for grades 9 to 11) and two week writing and algebra workshops combine small classes with daily athletics, arts and weekend trips around New England.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer@Taft page: 2027 dates for Young Scholars and Liberal Studies (July 5 to 30) and the two week Young Writer's Lab, Writer's Lab and Algebra I Workshop (July 5 to 16 and July 19 to 30). Address and phone in the page footer. Session prices are the boarding rates.

Researched by Claude from this page. Tuition and Fees for 2027: four week boarding $9,000 all inclusive; full time day students $4,500 (includes lunch, 8 am to 4:30 pm weekdays); two week programs $5,750 all inclusive. Limited need based aid for U.S. students in Young Scholars or Liberal Studies; none for two week programs.
Researched by Claude from this page. Young Scholars: for middle school students; applicants must be 12 by June 1 of the program year.
Researched by Claude from this page. Liberal Studies: for high school students in grades 9 to 11.
